tagline: What people in Korea, the US, Japan, China and Europe are talking about on social media today, picked from news reports and scored.
empty_field: No {field} issue scored 5.0 or higher today.
cut_summary: {n} items left out for low scores
gh_note: {date} · all languages · in GitHub Trending order, not scored
disclaimer: Written with AI from public news reports and social media. Scores are editorial judgments, not measured social media volume. Social links open keyword searches, not individual posts.
method: Buzz (how much it will be talked about), impact (how far it reaches), timeliness (is it new today) and staying power (will it last for days) are each rated out of 10 and averaged.
Issues averaging under 5.0 are dropped, so some fields have fewer than 10. Dropped items are listed at the bottom of each tab.
Items marked “Gen Z trend” are picked from trend media and youth surveys covering what spreads on Reels, Threads and TikTok.
Scores are Claude's judgment based on news reports, not counts of posts.
